issues.headline: HomeView hits shelves today, and a reviewer could read her kid's texts on it
issues.brief: Apple's $299 HomeView (C$429) goes on sale today with strong reviews for hardware and family profiles, but The Verge found a nearby unlocked phone can expose another family member's messages. Meta's Muse now phones US businesses for paying subscribers, and a third party sells call-making to any agent. Instacart puts 20,000 Dollar General stores on 30-minute delivery, Greenlight posts its own HomeView comparison, and Maple's shutdown clock has seven weeks left.

zh.headline: HomeView 今日开售，评测人在上面读到了自家孩子的短信
zh.brief: 苹果 299 美元（加币 429）的 HomeView 今天上市，硬件和家庭档案好评居多，但 The Verge 发现只要附近有一部已解锁的手机，就能看到另一位家庭成员的短信。Meta 的 Muse 开始替美国付费用户给商家打电话，另有第三方把“打电话”能力卖给任何代理。Instacart 把两万家 Dollar General 门店接入 30 分钟送达，Greenlight 自己发了 HomeView 对比页，Maple 关停倒计时还剩七周。

issues.headline: Nori gives its family hub a wake word, and Google lets your personal agent program the house
issues.brief: Nori adds hands-free 'Hey Nori' voice to its family display and says 200,000 families already use it, the closest copy yet of Kora's own pitch. Google's Nov 11 Home update lets personal agents create automations and puts images in Gemini's display answers, while the Pixel Drop bundles family controls into a settings hub and lets Gemini phone businesses. Gopuff opens to Grok Bot, Grok Bot's call terms make you the caller of record, and Apple HomeView lands Friday without the EU.

zh.headline: Nori 给家庭屏加了唤醒词，Google 让个人代理直接编排家里的自动化
zh.brief: Nori 给自家家庭屏加上免提的“Hey Nori”语音，并称已有 20 万个家庭在用，这是目前最像 Kora 的一套说法。Google 11 月 11 日的 Home 更新让个人代理可以新建自动化，Gemini 在屏幕上的回答也开始带图；Pixel Drop 把家庭管理塞进设置页，还让 Gemini 替你给商家打电话。Gopuff 接入 Grok Bot，Grok Bot 的通话条款把你定为“主叫方”，Apple HomeView 周五开卖但不进欧盟。

issues.headline: Uber's AI agents booked four rides in a week, and Skylight answered with an egg timer
issues.brief: A slow Wednesday. Uber, DoorDash and Airbnb say outside AI agents bring in almost nothing, and they are betting on their own in-app helpers like photo-to-cart grocery. Skylight keeps shipping small free features, now timers. Alexa+ reaches the browser in Germany, with calendar entries from images on its roadmap.

zh.headline: Uber 的 AI 代理一周只叫了 4 趟车，Skylight 则回了一个煮蛋计时器
zh.brief: 周三消息不多。Uber、DoorDash 和 Airbnb 都说外部 AI 代理几乎没带来生意，转而押注自家应用里的助手，比如拍照变购物车。Skylight 继续推出免费小功能，这次是计时器。Alexa+ 在德国上了网页版，路线图上还有“图片生成日程”。

issues.headline: Meta's Muse agent reaches your wrist, and its helper model costs ten cents a million tokens
issues.brief: A slow Tuesday. Meta says its Muse agent now runs on Apple Watch and Wear OS, though the report rests on one roundup source. Meta also released Muse Ember, a very cheap model for repetitive agent work, which could push down the cost of always-on assistants.

zh.headline: Meta 的 Muse 代理戴上了手腕，配套小模型每百万 token 只要 10 美分
zh.brief: 周二消息不多。Meta 称 Muse 代理现在可在 Apple Watch 和 Wear OS 上运行，不过该消息目前只有一篇汇总文章作来源。Meta 还发布了 Muse Ember，一个专干重复代理活的超便宜模型，可能拉低常驻助手的成本。

issues.headline: Meta's Muse now builds family-event planners on request, and Apple's CEO is reportedly tired of waiting on Siri
issues.brief: A slow Monday. Meta's Muse agent can now spin up a Space for things like a holiday gift tracker or a family event recipe board, and keep it updated in the background. Apple's new CEO is reportedly pushing software chief Craig Federighi to move faster on Siri, days before HomeView ships.

zh.headline: Meta 的 Muse 现在能按需给你搭家庭活动计划板，苹果新 CEO 据说已经等 Siri 等得不耐烦
zh.brief: 周一消息不多。Meta 的 Muse 代理现在能按需建一个“空间”，比如节日礼物追踪或家庭聚会食谱板，还会在后台自动更新。据报道，苹果新 CEO 正催软件主管 Craig Federighi 加快 Siri 进度，而 HomeView 几天后就要发货。

issues.headline: Apple's kitchen screen is not out yet, and its code already guards your calendar
issues.brief: A slow Friday. Code in the iOS 27.3 beta shows Apple preparing chatbot apps for HomeView, plus a lockout that asks for an iPhone after repeated face-spoofing attempts. HomeView ships Nov 13 for $299. Meta's Muse agent learned to hold live voice chats with an animated avatar, US only for now.

zh.headline: 苹果厨房屏还没发货，代码里已经先给你的日历配了保安
zh.brief: 周五消息不多。iOS 27.3 测试版代码显示，苹果在为 HomeView 准备聊天机器人应用，还有反复冒充人脸后要用 iPhone 解锁的机制。HomeView 11 月 13 日发货，售价 299 美元。Meta 的 Muse 代理学会了带虚拟形象的实时语音聊天，暂时只限美国。

issues.headline: Amazon blocks outside shopping agents and says its own Alexa will win, with 400 million users as the receipt
issues.brief: A slow Thursday. Amazon is walling off its store from outside AI shopping agents like Meta's Muse, while Walmart and Shopify open the door. Amazon says 400 million people used Alexa for Shopping in the past year, and the biggest family-relevant change is that grocery lists are now a voice job.

zh.headline: 亚马逊把外部购物代理挡在门外，说自家 Alexa 会赢，证据是 4 亿用户
zh.brief: 周四消息不多。亚马逊正在把外部 AI 购物代理（比如 Meta 的 Muse）挡在商店之外，而沃尔玛和 Shopify 则敞开大门。亚马逊称过去一年有 4 亿人用过 Alexa 购物功能，对家庭最相关的变化是：购物清单现在可以直接用语音管。

issues.headline: Apple's kitchen screen ships Nov 13, and its $1,000 robot version may not show up until 2028
issues.brief: A slow Wednesday. HomeView lands on Nov 13 at $299 with recipes, calendar and FaceTime, tabletop or wall-mounted. A report says Apple's follow-up robot display may slip to 2028 because the software is not ready. Apple's own camera, lock and thermostat line starts shipping in December.

zh.headline: 苹果厨房屏 11 月 13 日发货，1000 美元的机器人版可能要拖到 2028 年
zh.brief: 周三消息不多。HomeView 11 月 13 日发售，售价 299 美元，有食谱、日历和 FaceTime，台式和壁挂两种。有报道称苹果后续的机器人屏幕可能因软件没准备好拖到 2028 年。苹果自家的摄像头、门锁和温控器 12 月开始发货。

issues.headline: The FTC wants to know if Instacart's price depends on who you are, and Amazon's Echoes now know who is in your kitchen
issues.brief: A slow Tuesday. The FTC ordered Instacart, DoorDash, Walmart and others to explain whether prices vary by person, which lands right on the checkout behind Kora's meal plans. Amazon's new Echo lineup adds voice and face recognition for family members.

zh.headline: FTC 想知道 Instacart 的价格是不是看人下菜碟，亚马逊的新 Echo 则开始认厨房里的人
zh.brief: 周二消息不多。FTC 要求 Instacart、DoorDash、沃尔玛等说明价格是否因人而异，正好落在 Kora 膳食计划的结账环节。亚马逊新 Echo 系列加入了对家人的声音和人脸识别。

issues.headline: Walmart's Sparky lands in Canada, and a text-message bot wants your family's dinner vote
issues.brief: A slow Monday. Walmart Canada launched its Sparky shopping assistant, which builds lists around a budget or a holiday meal and comes with a no-personalized-pricing pledge. Zest's text-message agent now books restaurants and works in group chats, but it also wants a link to your card.

zh.headline: 沃尔玛 Sparky 登陆加拿大，一个短信机器人想替你们全家投票选晚饭
zh.brief: 周一消息不多。沃尔玛加拿大上线 Sparky 购物助手，能按预算或节日大餐列清单，还承诺不按人定价。Zest 的短信 AI 现在能订餐厅、能进群聊，但也想关联你的信用卡。

issues.headline: Apple's $299 kitchen screen is already sold out until December, and Skylight just added a doorbell for the calendar
issues.brief: A quiet Sunday. Apple's HomeView preorders sold fast enough that some tabletop colors now ship in early December, while the wall-mount version has no delay. Skylight added notifications when someone adds an event, a small feature that shows where family calendars are heading.

zh.headline: 苹果 299 美元的厨房屏已经卖到十二月，Skylight 给日历装了个“门铃”
zh.brief: 周日消息不多。苹果 HomeView 预订火爆，部分台式颜色要到 12 月初才发货，壁挂版暂时没有延迟。Skylight 新增“有人添加日程就通知你”的功能，小改动，但能看出家庭日历往哪走。

issues.headline: AI agents placed a few hundred DoorDash orders. The hype just met the receipt
issues.brief: DoorDash says outside AI agents have sent it only several hundred orders, and Amazon's CEO called them 'still not great.' Meanwhile DoorDash's own AI reorder list got eight times faster and lifted orders 34%, and Instinct added OpenTable bookings with spending limits. Plus what free agents may really cost Meta.

zh.headline: AI 代理在 DoorDash 只下了几百单，热度撞上了小票
zh.brief: DoorDash 说外部 AI 代理迄今只给它带来几百单，亚马逊 CEO 也说这类代理“还不怎么样”。与此同时，DoorDash 自家的 AI 回购清单提速八倍，下单率涨了 34%；Instinct 接入 OpenTable 订位，还加了消费上限。另外算一笔账：免费代理到底让 Meta 花了多少钱。

issues.headline: Alexa wants your family's shopping list, and it's bringing a meal planner
issues.brief: Amazon gave Alexa 100+ shopping skills led by voice shopping lists, and the Echo Show's Family Organizer is getting a meal planning tab that will reach older devices. Meanwhile, two in three businesses hang up on AI agent calls, a warning for Kora Plus. Kroger and Amazon both doubled down on online groceries.

zh.brief: 亚马逊给 Alexa 加了 100 多项购物功能，打头的是语音购物清单；Echo Show 的“家庭管家”也新增膳食计划标签页，还会推给老设备。另一边，三家商户里有两家会挂掉 AI 代理的电话，给 Kora Plus 提了个醒。Kroger 和亚马逊都在加码线上买菜。
zh.headline: Alexa 盯上全家的购物清单，还顺手带来了膳食计划

issues.headline: DoorDash makes it official: Instacart is sold, and Kora's grocery checkout gets a new landlord
issues.brief: DoorDash signed a $17 billion deal to buy Instacart, the checkout behind Kora's meal plans, though closing is a year or more away. AI agents had a messy week on trust: Meta's Muse handed a Toronto seller's address to a buyer while Yelp and OpenAI pushed agents into phone calls and texts. Walmart opened its store to outside agents, a possible second grocery route.

zh.brief: DoorDash 签下 170 亿美元协议收购 Instacart，也就是 Kora 膳食计划背后的结账平台，不过交割还要一年以上。AI 代理这周在信任上很狼狈：Meta 的 Muse 把多伦多卖家的住址给了买家，而 Yelp 和 OpenAI 则把代理推进了电话和短信。Walmart 向外部代理开放下单，可能成为第二条买菜通道。
zh.headline: DoorDash 官宣买下 Instacart，Kora 的买菜结账换了房东

issues.headline: Amazon hangs a family calendar on the wall, and calls it a screen style
issues.brief: Amazon launched the Echo Show 16 with a Family Organizer mode, an Alexa photo frame and a $99 Echo Dot that doubles as a smart home hub. Nori is pitching a cheaper AI family hub against Hearth, and the DoorDash deal for Instacart could be signed this week.

zh.brief: 亚马逊发布带“家庭管家”模式的 Echo Show 16、一款 Alexa 相框，以及兼做智能家居中控的 99 美元 Echo Dot。Nori 拿更便宜的 AI 家庭屏叫板 Hearth，DoorDash 收购 Instacart 可能本周就签。
zh.headline: 亚马逊把家庭日历挂上了墙，还管它叫“屏幕风格”

issues.headline: DoorDash goes shopping for Instacart, and Kora's grocery button is in the cart
issues.brief: DoorDash is in advanced talks to buy Instacart for about $17 billion, which matters because Instacart is where Kora meal plans check out. Text-message AI agents aimed at families are multiplying, and two more family calendar makers pushed updates. Alexa+ is now free with Prime in the US and Canada.

zh.brief: DoorDash 正就约 170 亿美元收购 Instacart 深入谈判，而 Instacart 正是 Kora 膳食计划下单的地方。面向家庭的短信 AI 代理越来越多，另有两家家庭日历屏厂商推出新品和更新。Alexa+ 在美国和加拿大对 Prime 会员免费了。
zh.headline: DoorDash 想把 Instacart 装进购物车，Kora 的买菜按钮也在车里

issues.headline: Apple joins the fight for the kitchen screen
issues.brief: This first issue looks back over the past few weeks. The big shift: Apple announced HomeView and is now in the family display market. Skylight raised more money to push into AI assistants, and big players are fast turning AI phone calls and AI grocery shopping into standard features.

zh.brief: 首期先回顾过去几周。最大的变化是苹果发布 HomeView，正式进入家庭屏市场；Skylight 拿到更多资金往 AI 助理扩张；AI 代打电话和 AI 买菜也在被大厂快速做成标配。
zh.headline: 苹果入场，厨房那块屏变挤了
